name: Nanjing Railway New Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nanjing Railway New Technology Co.,Ltd. is dedicated to the innovation, development, and production of a broad spectrum of components for both the structural body and the bogie (undercarriage) systems of rail vehicles. Its extensive offerings include diverse car body elements like electrical system components, chassis parts, wall and roof panels, and cabin assemblies, alongside crucial traction braking systems. Moreover, the company manufactures vital bogie accessories such as shock absorbers and buffers. Beyond these, their portfolio encompasses carbon steel items, rubber parts, and specialized machine parts processing services. Established in 1994, the firm's operations are based in Nanjing, China.
